activation: No shared mold, history, Home route, decoder, service authorization, dispatch or saved state activation; no inventory registration. Current state must be bounded and authenticated by eventual Home/history wrapper; returned Doc and Run candidates require atomic single-timeline commit.
profile: Verified native person or agent only; service denied
Explicit current human Work owner; no inferred steward
Exact assigned agent, binding, immutable definition/runtime, original core grant and Work execution pins
Read access survives changed execution/assignment/Doc head while current visibility and membership are rechecked
Shared Doc target context only, <=4 targets and <=64KiB plus immutable input cap
Exact actual Doc submit command, full accepted receipt, body and attempt audit required before finish
Submitted result review does not need the lease cleared by finish; original authority/deadline expiry remains distinct from revocation

review.release: Independent source review approved at the recorded final hashes; no remaining finding, native execution still pending
review.root: Final full source and receipt-tightening review approved at exact recorded hashes
review.resolved_finding: Require the full closed native submit receipt with empty error, submitted state and exact expected/resulting lifecycle revisions; negative cases cover extra authority, wrong successor and nonempty error.
